stem: Which statement about the graph of \( y = \frac{1}{3} \left( \frac{2}{3} \right)^x \) is true?

options.label: A
options.text: The graph has a vertical asymptote.

options.label: B
options.text: The graph crosses the y-axis at \( 0 , \frac{2}{9} \).

options.label: C
options.text: The graph has an asymptote at \( y = \frac{1}{3} \).

options.label: D
options.text: The graph decreases from left to right.
